t: That, except as otherwise provided by law, all balances of appropriations contained in the annual appropriation bills and made specifically for the service of any fiscal year shall only be applied to the payment of expenses properly incurred during that year, or to the fulfillment of contracts properly made within that year.

fable.w: This provision only restricts how fiscal-year appropriation balances may be spent. The one tempting hook is the mention of "contracts", but that describes what the funds may pay for, not any consultation, hearing, rulemaking, advisory body, or right to sue. No party outside the federal government is brought into a federal decision.
fable.s: all balances of appropriations contained in the annual appropriation bills and made specifically for the service of any fiscal year shall only be applied to the payment of expenses properly incurred during that year

qwen_block.w: This section establishes rules for the use of federal appropriations, specifically limiting them to expenses incurred or contracts made within a specific fiscal year. It does not involve any consultation, coordination, or decision-making process with parties outside the federal government. There are no advisory boards, public hearings, or requirements for outside input mentioned.
qwen_block.s: all balances of appropriations contained in the annual appropriation bills and made specifically for the service of any fiscal year shall only be applied to the payment of expenses properly incurred during that year, or to the fulfillment of contracts properly made within that year.

opus.w: This section only limits how fiscal-year appropriations may be spent. It does not involve any outside party in a federal decision. The mention of "contracts" might look like outside involvement, but it only refers to which obligations the funds can pay. No comment period, hearing, consultation, advisory body, or right to sue is created.
opus.s: shall only be applied to the payment of expenses properly incurred during that year, or to the fulfillment of contracts properly made within that year

qwen_chat.w: This section establishes a fiscal rule regarding the timing of expenditure of appropriated funds. It does not require consultation, coordination, or input from any party outside the federal government before a decision is made. The reference to contracts is limited to the fulfillment of contracts already made, which falls under the exclusion for applications/contracts and does not constitute participation in a federal decision-making process.
qwen_chat.s: That, except as otherwise provided by law, all balances of appropriations contained in the annual appropriation bills and made specifically for the service of any fiscal year shall only be applied to the payment of expenses properly incurred during that year, or to the fulfillment of contracts properly made within that year.
qwen_chat.b: Tempting-but-wrong reading: One might argue that "contracts properly made" implies interaction with outside parties (contractors), and thus involves participation. However, the definition explicitly excludes applications for contracts, and this section merely sets a fiscal rule for when funds can be spent, not a process for consulting with outsiders before a decision is made. The actors involved in the decision to spend funds are internal federal officials.
